【原视频简介】
Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash is Google’s newest AI video model update and in this full breakdown, I test every major feature to find out how good it actually is.

Gemini Omni 1.1 Flash can generate videos from text, images, and video references while producing synchronized audio. The new version introduces videos up to 40 seconds long through scene extension, first-and-last-frame keyframing, improved character consistency, video references, a faster 360p draft mode, and 1080p and 4K exports.

But specifications don’t tell us whether an AI video generator is genuinely useful, so I put Gemini Omni 1.1 through a complete set of real-world tests.
#GeminiOmni #AIVideo #GoogleAI
